name: Daisuki na Onii-chan no Otoshikata ~Tsuntsun Imouto wa, Ani ni Deredere Deshita~
original_name: 大好きなお兄ちゃんの堕とし方 ～ツンツン妹は、兄にデレデレでした～
source:
My little sister, Seira…
Sometimes, I think she’s charming and cute, but most of the time, she’s a mischievous little sister who loves to tease me.
Maybe it’s because of the age gap, but I’ve never been genuinely annoyed with her.
She’s got a cute face, and she’s petite—a sharp, small-framed beauty, you could say.
At least, that’s how it was… until that night.

One late night, as I was sleeping, I felt something warm and damp covering my face.
Half-asleep, I barely opened my eyes to see…
"Eh… ah… huh?! Wha—?!"
To my shock, Seira was pressing her most intimate part against my face.
"Oh, you’re awake? Hehe… you can’t escape, you know♪"
Panicking, I tried to get away, but…
Seira had already prepared for this. She’d tied me to the bed.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01002913.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
我的妹妹圣罗……
有时候，我觉得她很可爱，很迷人，但大多数时候，她是一个调皮、爱捉弄我的小妹妹。
也许是因为年龄差距，但我从来没有真正生过她的气。
她有着一张可爱的脸，而且身材娇小，可以说是一个尖细的小美女。
至少，直到那天晚上都是这样。

一天深夜，我睡着的时候，感觉有什么温暖湿润的东西覆盖在我的脸上。
我半睡半醒，勉强睁开眼睛，看到了……
“呃……啊……啊？！什——？！”
令我震惊的是，Seira将她最私密的部位压在了我的脸上。
“哦，你醒了？呵呵……你是逃不掉的哦♪”
我惊慌失措，试图逃跑，但是……
圣罗对此早有准备。她把我绑在床上。
